Title: Forms Audit Trail: who touched your form data
Description:
See who viewed, edited, deleted and exported Umbraco Forms entries, who opened uploaded files, and who changed your form designs. Everything sits in one Audit dashboard in the Forms section.

The entry access audit records list views, entry opens, edits with before and after values (sensitive fields masked), deletes, exports and file downloads. It has its own retention, scrubs stored values when entries are erased, limits the log to chosen user groups and records who looked at the log itself. The design audit tracks changes to fields, pages, workflows and form settings with field-level diffs. Both have filters and CSV export.

Entry auditing is on by default and records personal data about your staff. Read the GDPR section of the README before you install.
